Diablo 4 Free Rewards Available For 48 Hours

Published Sep 13, 2026, 12:00 AM EDT

James is a gaming writer from London who has spent thousands of hours exploring titles from every genre. Though he has a particular affinity for multiplayer titles like World of Warcraft, Destiny 2 and League of Legends, he has also put thousands of hours into single-player experiences, from deep RPGs to epic PC strategies. When he's not playing or writing, he can usually be found supporting his beloved Brentford FC.

Blizzcon 2026 is now well underway, and all sorts of exciting announcements are going on around some of the developer's biggest and most successful titles. Diablo IV is very much one of those, with the hugely successful action RPG still going strong after the latest round of updates, following the Lord of Hatred expansion.

As is always the case with Blizzard's biggest celebration, there are plenty of free rewards to be had for those who count themselves as fans. With the event drawing to a close on September 13, here's everything you need to know about picking up those sweet in-game items before they go away forever.

As confirmed by Mobalytics, players can pick up Twitch Drops for Diablo IV, based on the amount of time watching participating channels streaming the game while Blizzcon is live. The full list of items and what you need to do to get them is as follows:

2 hours watch time: Serrated Skean (dagger).

4 hours watch time: Corroded Cleaver (axe).

6 hours watch time: Tintinnabulation (mace).

The fun doesn't stop there, as you can also get the exclusive Diablo Twitch badge by subscribing or gifting to a Diablo content creator. There are some additional items on over via the Blizzard store (which will be available a little beyond the end of the event), though you will actually have to pay for those if you want them for your account.

Specifically, the Diablo IV BlizzCon Bundle is available for $29.99 USD, and it comes with the Streamsnout pet, Indigo cat mount, and Escapeproof mount armor. Those items can also be secured by purchasing the BlizzCon Ultimate Collection Bundle ($49.99 USD), which also includes the Inidigo’s Light Mount Trophy and Indigo’s Master Mount Trophy. The UCB also includes items for other games from the company, including:

WoW

Rabbit'ath Flying Mount

Ensemble: Garb of the Dawnfire Phoenix transmog set

Perch of the Dawnfire Phoenix decor

Overwatch

Lich Queen Mei Legendary Skin

Frostmourne Ana Weapon Skin

Lichimari King Weapon Charm

Lich Queen Mei Spray

Diablo Immortal

Rimedarter Familiar Transmog

Seekers of Riddergrove (Violet) Portal

20 Legendary Crests

10 Telluric Pearls

Mother’s Lament 2-Star Legendary Gem

Hearthstone

Bloodmage Thalnos Signature Legendary

Blade of the Black Empire Card Back

5 Standard Card Packs

Those who are attending the convention in-person and have purchased an event pass for entry will also be entitled to claim the Ultimate Collection Bundle for free.

Season 15 is also expected to launch in the middle of this month, so it's a great time to jump back into Diablo IV if you haven't played for a while. Beyond that, we don't really know what's coming next just yet, but keep an eye out for major announcements during the panel for the game.

Players are set to return to the world of Sanctuary in Diablo 4. Set after the events of Diablo 3's Reaper of Souls DLC, Lilith, the daughter of Mephisto, has been summoned to the world and has assumed power in the absence of demons and angels. Lilith establishes Sanctuary as a haven for refugees caught in the crossfire between hell and heaven. Wanting to protect her kind from the recently emerged Nephelem, Lilith is banished to the void.
